Title: General availability: StorSimple 8000 series in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
Microsoft Azure StorSimple 8000 series management is generally available in the Azure portal. We'll transition all the existing customers to the new Azure portal by September 30, 2017. The transition process is quick and non-disruptive. All devices running Update 3 or later are eligible for the transition.

If your device is not up to date, we strongly recommend that you apply this update soon.

For more information on the Azure portal experience, visit the Azure blog.
